from tools import *
import base64,struct
# simple void no params entry -> variables 0 expected empty
V={'name':'V','kind':'void'}
c=base(types=[V],modules=[{'name':'m','params':[],'result':['r','V'],'requires':None}],entries=['m'])
def raw_kt(objbytes=b'',magic=b'KTEST',ver=3,args=b'',extra=b'',argc=None,syms=(0,0),objc=None):
 if argc is None: argc=0
 if objc is None: objc=0
 return magic+struct.pack('>I',ver)+struct.pack('>I',argc)+args+struct.pack('>II',syms[0],syms[1])+struct.pack('>I',objc)+objbytes+extra
def b64(b):return base64.b64encode(b).decode()
cases={
 'good':raw_kt(),
 'badmagic':raw_kt(magic=b'KTESX'),
 'badver':raw_kt(ver=2),
 'trail':raw_kt(extra=b'x'),
 'argc65':raw_kt(argc=65),
 'arg257':raw_kt(args=struct.pack('>I',257)+b'a'*257,argc=1),
 'badobjcount':raw_kt(objc=1),
}
for k,v in cases.items():
 out=run(c|{'runs':[{'entry':'m','ktest':b64(v)}]})
 print(k,out['records'])
# valid args 64 and each 256
args=b''.join(struct.pack('>I',256)+b'a'*256 for _ in range(64))
print('maxargs',run(c|{'runs':[{'entry':'m','ktest':b64(raw_kt(args=args,argc=64))}]})['records'])
# whitespace/noncanonical b64
for bad in [' '+b64(raw_kt()), b64(raw_kt())+'\n', b64(raw_kt())[:-1], b64(raw_kt())+'=', '!!!!']:
 print('b64',repr(bad[:10]),run(c|{'runs':[{'entry':'m','ktest':bad}]})['records'])
